description:
Who sponsors the channels on a subject: in the descriptions of its outliers, sponsor
    lines, promo codes and offer links found in code, plus Scrape Creators' sponsor read of
    videos YouTube marks as paid promotion, each named by one model read and kept only when
    the brand's name is in its own line. sponsors: brand, kind (sponsor, affiliate, other),
    channel_count and video_count (counted in code), channels, and videos with the evidence
    line as written, the code and the link. Costs 1 credit, refunded when the read fails.
    Same as POST /v1/sponsors. Read it back with get_call.

idempotency_key.description: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters; the same key and request within 24 hours answer the saved remix and charge nothing; the same key with another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused
